continuity_scope: Bound to the Avalon Hill/Hasbro HeroQuest Game System retail core, product F3649, copyright 2021. Hasbro announced the retail relaunch on November 15, 2021 and said it would ship in December 2021; no more precise official retail street date was verified. This is the 2021 Avalon Hill remake/relaunch, not the 1989 MB/Games Workshop game, a HasLab tier with exclusive content, First Light, or any later product.
work_or_witnesses: Avalon Hill HeroQuest Game System, F3649, Hasbro, 2021 retail core
Avalon Hill - HeroQuest Instructions, F3649, official Hasbro download
coverage_rule: Include a named person only where the official core-product witness supplies a stable individual identity and dramatic role. Zargon qualifies as the named Dread sorcerer opposing the heroes and as the in-game Game Master role. Barbarian, Dwarf, Elf, and Wizard are title-only, player-selected hero roles; monsters, spells, objects, rooms, quests, and other mechanics remain terms. Mentor is omitted because the selected retail-core product description does not provide a claim-level profile, despite later app narration references.
omissions: The original 1989 MB/Games Workshop editions and their regional rules, names, artwork, and continuity.
HasLab Heroic/Mythic tier exclusive materials, including exclusive figures and quest books, even when marketed as part of the 2020 relaunch campaign.
All quest packs, expansions, First Light, downloadable/player-created quests, app content, novels, video games, and other adaptations.
The four player heroes and all hero names chosen by players, because the core product defines only role titles, not stable named individuals.
Mentor, named quest NPCs, and villains not directly claim-level profiled in the bounded retail-core product evidence.
uncertainties: The public F3649 instructions download is an official 10.29 MB resource, but the accessible web rendering does not expose a searchable rulebook/Quest Book text. This pass relies on claim-level official product and announcement text rather than transcribing images.

No official core F3649 errata, revision log, or retcon policy was found in the reviewed witness set. The downloadable instructions file is not treated as proof of a later rules revision merely because its hosting metadata may change.

The Companion App is an optional Digital Zargon mode with its own supported languages, saving, options, later expansion plans, and house-rule feedback path; it is not a replacement continuity for tabletop core play.
HeroQuest depicts fantasy combat, monsters, traps, death/defeat, evil forces, and dungeon horror. Class/species labels are genre/game roles rather than claims about real peoples or occupations.
evidence_basis: Official Hasbro/Avalon Hill instructions, newsroom, and Companion App documentation only. No fan wikis, Wikipedia, unofficial rules scans, or player-created quest material were used as canonical evidence.

supports: Identifies F3649 and describes the Game Master, four hero roles, 14 quests, components, and player-created quests.
Dates the retail relaunch announcement, identifies it as an all-new retail version, and states December shipment intent.
Establishes the Companion App as optional and distinct from the standard tabletop Zargon role.
